title: Fabulous app for walkers and hikers alike!
content: Amazing app with so much information on so many walks and hikes! I’m amazed how many walks are on the app helping me explore even my own area let alone the rest of the world! One comment to hopefully get in a future update would be to allow you to add your own comments to yourself when you save the walk eg. Stop 20km in for a cool Hidden feature or something. Or even a camping spot. Just things like that so personal comments you don’t want to post that others won’t necessarily find helpful. Also the search feature on the map is very confusing. I want to search town ect. On the map too to see the walks in that area, not have to find it by moving the map as some places are hard to find, so a search for areas/places, not just walks in the map would be great. Otherwise it’s a brilliant app
author: Tebom4eva

title: Great App
content: I have to say what a great app. Probably the best one I have found. I went for the pro and don’t mind paying that as it’s worth it. I use it a lot for trail running, hiking and even let the kids use it with me. At times while running round mountains I wanted to extend my route , this app will give you an alarm to say your off route and give you a choice to carry on or get back on track. Has always worked, gives you a lot of information while running or hiking,elevation, distance,pace, and more. Lots of choices on trails and tracks. You select a track it highlights it and gps is on. Big thank you for this app certainly recommend it if you do a lot of walk’s etc.
author: tobiaspul

title: Wanna stay safe outdoors - All Trails
content: 💯Awesome app. Love it, so easy to use. I downloaded the Pro version so I can use maps offline and it has already saved me twice from going off track. If you want extra security outdoors walking, hiking, cycling or even on the water download this app❤️
author: Kauri and Ariana

title: I want to love the app but…
content: I want to love AllTrails. I like a lot about it. But twice it has shortened my route. The most recent time was today. I used the Apple watch app. I checked it a few times during my walk/jog, and it seemed to be working fine. I finished my route at around 1:10pm. The watch synced to my phone…and when I checked AllTrails said I finished at 12:47pm. I didn’t pause my workout during it, I kept moving, so I have no idea where the other 20 or so minutes have gone. I was contemplating getting ‘Peak’, but today has totally put me off.
author: Huttgal

title: Best hiking app - but just need 1 little improvement
content:
This is the best hiking app out there and i use the pro version.
The only improvement it needs is that when we are on trail it does show our location on the map and let us know how far we have come on the trail but it doesn’t show that information on the elevation chart in real time.
 Also if we can zoom in the elevation chart/profile of a given trail that'll be awesome.

author: tiger_490

title: Very average maps for MTB
content:
The usability is severely lacking for the mountain biking maps. The trails and details are way too small and fiddly, there’s no way of easily seeing what grades the tracks are or whether they’re both directions or single track. Makes it very difficult to plan rides in unfamiliar places, which is half the purpose of the app. Other similar apps colour code tracks for different grades and clearly show the name and directions which is much better. Safe to say I’ll be switching.

I wish I hadn’t subscribed, not worth the money.
